# proxmox_node_ceph_log (Data Source)

Lists Ceph daemon log lines from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/log`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_log" "l" {
  node  = "pve-1"
  limit = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Optional

- `limit` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
